name: OpenLara
description:
OpenLara is an open-source, modern engine reimplementation of classic Tomb Raider games (Tomb Raider 1 through 5). Built with modern rendering techniques, it brings Lara Croft's original adventures to modern PCs.

Features:
- Real-time dynamic lighting, water reflections, and ambient occlusion
- Smooth 60 FPS and uncapped framerate gameplay with true widescreen rendering
- First-person and third-person camera perspective toggles
- Full controller support with modern analog stick and mouse controls
- Supports original level files and audio tracks from Tomb Raider 1 to 5
